2608.02569.title: AtumAI: A Principled Framework for Agentic Generation of Datacenter Control-Plane Policies
2608.02569.paper_summary: The efficiency of a datacenter rests on its control plane policies. Designing these policies is increasingly hard: the hardware-software stack grows fast, the design space is vast and interdependent, and prototyping a single policy takes months. Agentic AI promises to automate this search. Off the shelf, however, it falls short on three fronts. It is not formal: with no structured, searchable statement of the problem, the search has little structure to exploit and hard constraints are not guaranteed. It is not transferable: each task is solved from scratch, so nothing learned on one task carries to the next. Finally, it is not systematic: relying on the LLM as the sole source of candidates, it explores a narrow slice of the design space and settles into local optima. We introduce AtumAI, a framework that generates datacenter control-plane policies with agentic AI, making the process formal, transferable, and systematic. From a goal stated in plain language, AtumAI autonomously proposes, tests, and refines candidate policies until one satisfies the request. It does so through two components. The Datacenter Task Compiler automates problem formulation: it compiles the request into a formal, machine-checkable, and searchable specification of the task's objectives, constraints, decision variables, and evaluation methodology. The Evolutionary Design Discovery Loop then searches this specification, expanding the search beyond the LLM itself via a diffusion model, an evolutionary algorithm, and a surrogate model. Together, they reduce onboarding a new task from months of engineering to writing its description. We evaluate AtumAI on three control-plane tasks with distinct problem scopes, design spaces, and trade-offs: workload placement, resource scaling, and power management. Across all tasks, the policies generated by AtumAI consistently outperform expert-engineered baselines.
2608.02569.paper_summary_zh: 資料中心的效率取決於其控制平面政策。設計這些政策變得越來越困難：硬體-軟體堆疊快速增長，設計空間廣泛且相互依賴，並且原型設計單一政策需要數月時間。Agentic AI 承諾自動化這一搜尋。然而，現成的解決方案在三個方面有所不足。它不是正式的：沒有結構化、可搜尋的問題陳述，搜尋幾乎沒有結構可供利用，並且硬性約束無法保證。它不是可轉移的：每個任務都是從頭開始解決，因此在一個任務上學到的東西無法轉移到下一個任務。最後，它不是系統性的：依賴 LLM 作為唯一的候選來源，它探索的設計空間狹窄，並且停留在局部最優解。我們介紹 AtumAI，一個利用 agentic AI 生成資料中心控制平面政策的框架，使這一過程變得正式、可轉移和系統化。從用簡單語言陳述的目標出發，AtumAI 自主提出、測試並完善候選政策，直到滿足請求。它通過兩個組件實現這一目標。資料中心任務編譯器自動化問題的表述：它將請求編譯成正式的、機器可檢查的和可搜尋的任務目標、約束、決策變量和評估方法的規範。進化設計發現循環則在這一規範中搜尋，通過擴散模型、進化算法和替代模型將搜尋擴展到 LLM 本身之外。這兩者共同將新任務的上線從數月的工程縮短為撰寫其描述。我們在三個具有不同問題範疇、設計空間和權衡的控制平面任務上評估 AtumAI：工作負載放置、資源擴展和電力管理。在所有任務中，AtumAI 生成的政策始終超越專家設計的基準。
